Name: Jahath, Son of Shelomith
Summary: Son of Shelomith of the Izharites in the rest of the sons of Levi.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 24:22: Son of Shelomith of the Izharites in the rest of the sons of Levi.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Jahath stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
